item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Paradiso Girls feat. Eve - Patron Tequila (20.05.2009) - Logo NewNowNext Awards - Highest Quality
item.description:
Hi everyone!

I'm looking for the highest-quality surviving recording of the Paradiso Girls performing "Patron Tequila" feat. Eve at the 2009 Logo NewNowNext Awards.

Date: May 20, 2009
Venue: Hiro Ballroom, New York City
Event: Logo NewNowNext Awards 2009
Performance: Paradiso Girls feat. Eve - "Patron Tequila"

I already found a full-length copy of the performance on YouTube, but I'm hoping someone may have a higher-quality source.

I'm looking for the highest-quality version available, preferably an original Logo digital recording, broadcast/DVR capture, TV rip, or another clean source with minimal re-encoding/compression.

If anyone has this performance or knows where a better-quality version can be found, I would really appreciate your help.

Thank you!
